title: Sr Transactions Manager
description:
The role 
 Were looking for a Manager, Transaction Management, to support some of the worlds largest companies(client s) across the world covering Asia (APAC) , Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and other parts of the globe. You ll be based in Gurugram, India. 

 What this job involves 
 Leading strategy, not just transactions. This is a strategic leadership role. Youll turn portfolio data and market insight into advice that shapes how some of the worlds largest companies use real estate across Globally. Youll own the delivery of complex transactions, but your biggest impact comes from setting account direction, advising senior stakeholders and building the teams, governance and analytics that keep the platform consistent across regions. The role blends hands-on ownership, team leadership and enterprise-level influence. Youll coordinate medium-complex transactions independently, lead high-complexity transactions end to end, and set the strategic agenda for multi-service accounts that span regions. 

 Key responsibilities 
 Lead transactions end to end: Independently coordinate medium-complex transactions and lead high-complexity ones, including lease acquisitions, renewals and terminations, with full delivery accountability. Direct broker and market strategy: Negotiate with brokers, challenge market inputs and direct strategy across the account portfolio to secure favorable positions. Uphold standards: Make sure account workflows, approval protocols and documentation standards are followed across the team, and that trackers, approval packs, lease inputs and critical dates are accurate. Present financial analysis: Present analyses to clients, including NPV, cash flow and PL models, with clear strategic and commercial implications. Manage RFPs and close actions: Direct RFP strategy and commercial positioning across the portfolio, coordinating legal and finance input through to award, and close open actions within agreed timelines. 

 Client and stakeholder partnership 
 Set account direction: Use deep knowledge of each clients business and portfolio to shape account strategy and hold relationship oversight across accounts. Coordinate stakeholders: Lead internal and external broker meetings and manage stakeholder expectations across regions. Lead workshops and strategic sessions, and lead client communication and presentations so expectations are managed directly. Anticipate and respond: Respond with urgency and flag risks before they affect delivery. Grow account value: Develop strategic solutions that strengthen account value and set the growth agenda across multi-service accounts. 

 Strategic advisory and platform governance 
 Portfolio strategy: Help define and deliver medium portfolio strategy advisory services to clients, providing strategic insights and recommendations that align with their business objectives Lead advisory on complex decisions: Advise senior client decision-makers on portfolio options, with clear rationale, risk assessment and recommendations. Set governance standards: Set governance and reporting standards, including quarterly business reviews and KPI reviews, for consistent delivery across the platform. Drive process improvement: Turn stakeholder feedback into workflow changes, redesign account workflows and embed the revised process across the team. Partner across service lines: Coordinate all service lines to deliver integrated, multi-service client solutions. 

 Digital, data and innovation 
 Champion the toolset: Use RFFT, MAPIT, Blackbird, SmartSheet, PAT, Excel, AI, dashboards and JLL GPT to improve speed, accuracy and consistency, and set the example for your team. Protect data quality: Maintain clean, structured data across trackers, reports and documentation. Automate: Identify manual, repetitive tasks, then build and deploy automation that measurably reduces effort and turnaround time. Standardize: Standardize templates and recurring deliverables as best practice for the team. 

 Culture and brand 
 Lead and develop teams: Lead teams of more than five people for extended periods (six months or more), organize day-to-day workload, mentor junior colleagues, and lead learning, development and knowledge management. Collaborate: Work effectively with peers, account teams, brokers and cross-functional teams across regions. Represent JLL: Demonstrate integrity, confidentiality and responsible ownership, and represent JLL with executive presence in senior client and leadership forums. 

 How youll work 
 Relationship management: Youll build strong, lasting relationships and help clients navigate the JLL delivery platform efficiently. Youll understand account profitability and shape account plans that meet revenue, performance and client service targets. Commercial acumen: Youll prepare and challenge financial analysis, contribute to client budget forecasting and forecast revenue, initiating and closing projects to meet monthly cashflow plans. Youll use technology and new products within JLL to deliver next-generation benefits for clients. Operating across regions: Can you see the bigger picture Can you juggle regional delivery that aligns to a global strategy As the Transaction Management lead supporting EMEA, APAC and Global accounts, youll bring each regions successes and risks to the forefront, offer practical solutions, and guide clients and teams toward proven processes and portfolio strategies.

title: International Operations Coordinator USA and INDIA with B1 B2 Visa
description:
ROLE SUMMARY 
 The selected candidate must be willing and able to divide their working time between India and the United States approximately six months in India and six months in the USAdepending on the company’s operational requirements. 
 During the U.S. assignment, the candidate will be responsible for organizing and coordinating warehouse operations, inventory management, order fulfillment, logistics, vendor communication, and operational reporting. The candidate will also participate in trade shows, coordinate product displays and show-floor activities, interact directly with customers, secure orders, and enter and process those orders accurately. Additional business and operational responsibilities may be assigned as required. 
 The candidate must be adaptable, highly organized, and willing to handle multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced working environment. A valid U.S. visa and appropriate authorization permitting employment in the United States are mandatory. Candidates already holding valid U.S. work authorization will be strongly preferred. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Coordinate daily business activities between the company’s India and U.S. operations. Work directly with the founders and senior management on international business-development projects. Coordinate with customers, vendors, consultants, logistics providers, and business associates in the United States. Travel to the United States for business meetings, conferences, negotiations, site visits, and other legally permitted business activities. Maintain clear communication and timely execution across different time zones. Prepare reports, presentations, business correspondence, schedules, and follow-up records. Monitor assigned projects and ensure that tasks are completed within the agreed timelines. Represent the company professionally during domestic and international meetings. Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive company and business information. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Any bachelor’s degree; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Three to ten years of relevant professional experience. Excellent written and spoken English. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and standard business applications. Excellent coordination, reporting, organizational, and follow-up skills. Ability to travel frequently between India and the United States. A valid U.S. B-1/B-2 visa is strongly preferred. Candidates with prior experience living, traveling, or conducting business in the United States will be given preference. Candidates must comply with all applicable U.S. immigration and employment requirements. Any work requiring U.S. employment authorization may be performed only by individuals holding valid authorization. 
 IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, dependable, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with senior leadership. The person should have a practical, hands-on approach and be capable of independently managing international coordination assignments. 
 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS Competitive fixed salary Performance-based incentives Company-paid approved business-travel expenses Airfare, accommodation, local transportation, and applicable daily allowances Significant opportunities for career growth and expanded responsibilities 
 INDUSTRY Furniture, Furnishings, International Trade and Business Operations 
 FUNCTIONAL AREA International Operations, Business Coordination and Founder’s Office
